tasks.title: Retrieve Argentina-Washington correspondence, 1921-1925
tasks.collection: Embajada en Washington, Estados Unidos I (27.A)
tasks.research_gap: Underlying Argentine diplomatic records have not been examined. They may locate the origin of the Daumas/Dumont attribution and document what Argentina transmitted to Washington.
tasks.critical_rule: Preserve Daumas, Dumont, or any other attribution exactly as written; do not normalize disputed names. Distinguish a record authored by Argentine officials from an enclosure or copied U.S. statement.
tasks.high_value_result: A dated Argentine-origin record identifying the sculptor, original work, fabrication or copy process, donor, or information formally transmitted to the U.S. government.

tasks.title: Retrieve Revista Legado No. 3 San Martin source trail
tasks.repository: Archivo General de la Nacion, Argentina / libraries holding Revista Legado
tasks.collection: Revista Legado, Publicacion Digital No. 3, August 2016; Nicolas Gutierrez material cited by Instituto Nacional Sanmartiniano
tasks.research_gap: The Instituto Nacional Sanmartiniano explicitly identifies Revista Legado No. 3 as the source behind its list of foreign copies of the Buenos Aires Daumas monument, including Washington. The underlying article and its own citations have not been ingested.
priority_units: Retrieve the complete Revista Legado No. 3 article by Nicolas Gutierrez
Capture the pages identifying Washington as a copy
Capture footnotes, bibliography, archival call numbers and image captions supporting the Washington statement
tasks.critical_rule: Treat the 2016 article as a downstream research source until its cited archival roots are identified. Do not count the Instituto republication and Revista Legado as independent lineages when the former explicitly inherits from the latter.
tasks.high_value_result: The complete article plus the exact upstream archival or bibliographic source used for the Washington-copy statement.

tasks.title: Retrieve Uruguay-Washington Artigas correspondence, 1947-1951
tasks.repository: Archivo Historico-Diplomatico, Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores, Uruguay
tasks.collection: Sub Fondo Legaciones y Embajadas, 2.10 Embajada de la Republica en Estados Unidos (1900-1990)
tasks.research_gap: The underlying 1947-1951 diplomatic correspondence has not been examined. It may establish donor language, fabrication, casting, shipment, installation, dedication, and the relationship between the Washington bronze and the San Jose de Mayo monument.
priority_units: Request inventory or folder-level description for 1947-1951
Retrieve folders concerning Artigas, Washington, statue shipment, casting or dedication
Capture enclosures separately from covering diplomatic correspondence
tasks.critical_rule: Separate fabrication and casting from authorship/model lineage. Record enclosures as distinct documents and preserve any cited upstream source rather than assigning the covering diplomatic record independent credit.
tasks.high_value_result: A contemporaneous Uruguayan record identifying who authorized, fabricated, cast, shipped, presented, or described the Washington Artigas statue and its relationship to the San Jose de Mayo monument.

tasks.title: Retrieve the 21 Aug 1949 El Dia Artigas article
tasks.repository: Anaforas / Universidad de la Republica and Biblioteca Nacional de Uruguay ecosystem
tasks.collection: Suplemento Dominical de El Dia, 21 Aug 1949
tasks.research_gap: Indexes identify a pre-dedication article titled 'Monumento a Artigas en Washington', but the underlying pages have not been retrieved.
priority_units: Retrieve the complete article and continuation pages
Record issue number, page numbers, author/byline, captions and photographs
Capture adjacent source or credit lines that reveal official publicity or wire-copy origin
tasks.critical_rule: The index proves only that an item existed. After retrieval classify the article as original reporting, official/diplomatic publicity, wire copy, editorial, or unknown; repeated official language is not an independent root.
tasks.high_value_result: A complete scan with bibliographic metadata and text or images bearing on production, financing, shipment, installation, or donor narrative.

tasks.title: Retrieve the 1894 Blanes commission and 1896 Dante Costa contract
tasks.repository: Uruguay government archives / Diario Oficial / relevant San Jose administrative archive
tasks.collection: Records underlying the historical findings reproduced in Resolution 732/004
tasks.research_gap: Uruguay's 2004 heritage resolution identifies two precise upstream events but the underlying records are not yet represented: the 14 Nov 1894 decision commissioning Juan Luis Blanes and the 25 Jul 1896 contract with Dante Costa.
priority_units: 14 Nov 1894 commission or administrative decision assigning the Artigas statue to Juan Luis Blanes
25 Jul 1896 contract with Dante Costa
Any attached specifications identifying model, plaster, casting, dimensions, payment, supervision or destination
tasks.critical_rule: Retrieve the underlying act or contract, not another later summary of it. Distinguish commission/authorship, model execution, plaster work and bronze casting as separate propositions.
tasks.high_value_result: Images or authoritative reproductions of the original 1894 and 1896 records with archival identifiers and complete relevant clauses.

tasks.title: Retrieve the U.S. diplomatic spine for the Cuban Friendship Urn, 1926-1928
tasks.repository: National Archives and Records Administration, United States
tasks.collection: RG 59, General Records of the Department of State, 1910-29 Central Decimal File; USS Maine memorial in Cuba
tasks.research_gap: The preserved U.S. diplomatic spine needs reconstruction and comparison with independently recoverable Cuban contemporary records. Unequal archival survival must not be treated as greater truthfulness.
priority_units: File 837.413M28/16 - Despatch No. 172, Noble Brandon Judah to Secretary of State, 10 Apr 1928
National Archives Microfilm Publication M488, roll 55 - entire file 837.413M28
Surrounding 1926-1928 correspondence on fabrication, transfer, custody, ceremony and material lineage
tasks.critical_rule: Separate ceremony/presentation, object identity, and material provenance. Missing or inaccessible Cuban-side records are ARCHIVAL_GAP, not negative evidence.
tasks.high_value_result: Contemporaneous records that separately establish the 1928 transfer, identify the object, and document or directly trace the claimed reuse of material from the damaged Havana Maine memorial.

tasks.title: Recover an independent Cuban contemporary record lane for the Friendship Urn
tasks.repository: Multiple Cuban and international digitized repositories
tasks.collection: Cuban newspapers, official publications, presidential or diplomatic texts, Sixth International Conference materials and historical photographs, 1926-1928
tasks.research_gap: A Cuban-origin contemporary lane is needed to test the U.S. diplomatic account without assuming a complete mirror archive survives or is remotely accessible.
priority_units: 1926 hurricane and damage to the Havana Maine memorial
January-April 1928 ceremony and transfer reporting
Statements describing fabrication or material reuse
Historical images documenting the memorial, fragments, urn, inscription or ceremony
tasks.critical_rule: Classify newspaper and published records by origin: original reporting, official-text reproduction, diplomatic release, wire copy, editorial, or unknown. Multiple reproductions of one upstream statement remain one lineage.
tasks.high_value_result: A Cuban-origin contemporary source independent of the U.S. State Department chain that confirms, contradicts, qualifies, or more precisely describes fabrication, material origin, presentation, or custody.

tasks.title: Retrieve the 1929 Public Buildings and Public Parks report and RG 42 installation records
tasks.repository: U.S. Government publication holdings and National Archives, RG 42
tasks.collection: Annual Report of the Director of Public Buildings and Public Parks of the National Capital, FY1929 (SuDoc PB 1.1:929), especially p. 64; related RG 42 operational records
tasks.research_gap: Later NPS documentation cites the 1929 annual report for the urn, but the underlying page and associated operational records have not been inspected.
priority_units: PB 1.1:929, p. 64, plus enough surrounding pages to preserve context
Late-1928 and 1929 RG 42 monthly reports of operations
Related work orders, correspondence, photographs, site plans, receipt, installation or custody records
tasks.critical_rule: Do not infer the contents of p. 64 from the later NPS citation. Separate receipt, installation, dedication, custody, presentation and material provenance; each requires text that actually addresses that proposition.
tasks.high_value_result: The complete cited page and related contemporary administrative records documenting what the federal park agency received, installed, recorded or knew about the urn in 1928-1929.
